problem: The original seasonal-shoulder interaction model included rain_z and rain_z:shoulder but omitted the shoulder main effect, violating the hierarchical interaction principle. The original H3 p-value is therefore not used as confirmatory evidence in the revised manuscript.
original_formula: prop ~ rain_z + rain_z:shoulder + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
repaired_primary_formula: prop ~ rain_z * shoulder + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
four_window_sensitivity_formula: prop ~ rain_z * shoulder + C(State) + C(RouteType) + year_z
four_window_rationale: Within states having exactly four survey windows, shoulder is deterministically run 1 or 4 and is collinear with C(RunNumber); the sensitivity therefore removes C(RunNumber) while retaining the shoulder main effect.
interpretation: Specification repair / robustness only. It cannot rescue or upgrade the original H3 confirmatory status.
